# Settings

Every setting of desktop-themes-rs is declared once, in
[`crates/desk-settings/src/registry.rs`](../crates/desk-settings/src/registry.rs). From that
registry `cargo xtask gen` generates the GSettings schema
(`data/io.github.OlehDzhumyk.Desk.gschema.xml`), the typed Rust accessors
(`crates/desk-settings/src/accessors.rs`) and this page; the window builds its preference pages
from it at run time (`themes gui --page <page>`). `cargo test` fails while a generated file is
out of date.

Labels are English gettext ids; the Ukrainian texts are in `po/uk.po` (see
[i18n.md](i18n.md)). Change values with the window, or e.g.
`gsettings set io.github.OlehDzhumyk.Desk.Clipboard history-size 100`.

Colour keys hold a CSS colour or are empty; the window, `themes apply` and the extension that reads them accept only `#rgb`, `#rgba`, `#rrggbb`, `#rrggbbaa`, `rgb()` and `rgba()` (anything else would end up in a style string).

## Features

| Feature | Origin |
|---|---|
| Clipboard (`clipboard`) | Available in Windows 11 and macOS; Based on Clipboard Indicator (MIT) |
| Volume mixer (`mixer`) | From Windows, adapted for macOS; Based on wiremix (MIT OR Apache-2.0) |
| Appearance (`appearance`) | From macOS, adapted for Windows 11 style |
| Focus (`focus`) | Available in Windows 11 and macOS |
| Logo menu (`logo-menu`) | From macOS |
| Lock screen (`lockscreen`) | Available in Windows 11 and macOS |
| Application (`app`) | — |

## Shortcuts

The theme default is written into the key in force (what the bridge binds); the override wins, survives theme switches and is re-applied by every `themes apply`. Empty override = follow the theme; `['disabled']` = no shortcut.

| Id | Label | Feature | Key in force | Override |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `clipboard-toggle` | Open the clipboard panel | clipboard | `/io/github/OlehDzhumyk/Desk/clipboard/toggle-shortcut` | `/io/github/OlehDzhumyk/Desk/shortcuts/clipboard-toggle` |
| `mixer-open` | Open the volume mixer | mixer | `/io/github/OlehDzhumyk/Desk/mixer/mixer-shortcut` | `/io/github/OlehDzhumyk/Desk/shortcuts/mixer-open` |
